items.title: SemiAnalysis publishes first open TPU inference benchmarks
items.body: Dylan Patel and SemiAnalysis team release InferenceX Official Preview results for Google TPUv7 Ironwood. Up to 50% better performance per dollar versus B200/B300 in aggregated FP8 serving on open-weight models. TorchTPU stack progressing toward day-0 support in vLLM/SGLang; expected open-source around October. Reduces CUDA moat narrative for external inference customers.

items.title: China’s Moonshot and Z.ai bring AI model subscription race to Tmall’s retail shelves
items.body: Z.ai (Zhipu) opened Tmall storefront for GLM Coding Plan last week; Tmall launched AI Space Station marketplace selling subscriptions and tokens from Alibaba Cloud, Z.ai, MiniMax and DeepSeek. Transactions jumped >160% in 48 hours. Moonshot and MiniMax in talks for flagship stores. Consumer packaging of AI plans as retail goods to drive recurring revenue.
